description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents “Sunset Beach 202B,” where every moment feels like a dream. Wake up to Gulf views, lounge by the pool, and explore Seacrest, Rosemary, and Alys Beach on included bikes. With plenty of room to spread out and just steps from sugar-white sand, this oceanfront oasis is perfect for unforgettable memories. Enjoy coffee on the balcony or sunsets over the waves, where luxury meets the magic of 30A. Ready to make it yours? Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf Views: Wake up to breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the sparkling Gulf from your own private 2nd-floor balcony—a perfect spot for morning coffee or sunset cocktails.Steps to Beach & Pool: Enjoy ultimate convenience with just a few steps separating you from the sandy shores and the refreshing pool. Relaxation is always within reach.6 Bikes Included: Feel the coastal breeze as you explore the charming streets of Seacrest, Rosemary, and Alys Beach on beach bikes—adventure awaits around every corner.Gated Community: Escape to a quiet, private haven with a safe and charming atmosphere, where tranquility meets exclusivity for a truly peaceful getaway.Spacious Design: With 1834 sq ft of open, airy living spaces, unwind in comfort—perfect for cozy family moments or dining with friends in style.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “The property was exactly as described – clean, spacious, and just a short walk to the beach. Perfect for families!” – David P.⭐ “Beautiful home with great views and easy access to everything. We loved the included bikes!” – Sarah L.⭐ "Great location and relaxing atmosphere. The pool and beach access were unbeatable!" – Matthew P.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into the open-concept living area with cozy seating, a gas fireplace, and large windows showcasing Gulf and pool views. Whether relaxing with a book or enjoying family movie night, this space is both inviting and functional.Comfortable designers seating and spacious layoutLarge windows with Gulf and pool viewsSmart TV for entertainmentGas fireplace for added warmth and ambiance*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully stocked kitchen is perfect for whipping up meals with ease. Gather around the dining table with Gulf views as your backdrop for unforgettable family dinners.Modern appliances and ample counter spaceBreakfast bar seating for 2Dining table seating for 8*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***This spacious home comfortably sleeps up to 10 guests across 4 bedrooms and features premium linens and exquisite colonial-style furnishings in every room.Primary King Suite: King bed, dedicated work desk and en-suite Bathroom with dual vanities and tub/shower comboPrimary Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, with en-suite Bathroom with tub/shower comboQueen/Bunk Guest Bedroom: Queen bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, smart TVSecondary Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, smart TVShared Hallway Bathroom with tub/shower combo, equipped with essential amenities*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES & LOCATION ***Nestled in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this gated community offers luxury amenities and unbeatable convenience. Surrounded by boutique shops, restaurants, and scenic paths, you’re just steps away from adventure.Direct beach access: Step right onto the soft, sandy shores for serene strolls and breathtaking Gulf views.Private community pool with Gulf views: Relax and unwind by the pool while soaking in stunning panoramic ocean scenery.5-min walk to Seacrest Beach Town Center: Discover a lively hub filled with boutique shops, casual cafes, and welcoming vibes perfect for a laid-back afternoon.9-min walk to Alys Beach: Wander into this stunning, upscale coastal town known for its pristine white architecture and a tranquil, luxurious atmosphere.11-min walk to Rosemary Beach: Explore the charm of cobblestone streets, charming boutiques, and a vibrant yet elegant community feel.Peddler’s Pavilion & Scenic 30A: Rent a bike and ride along the iconic 30A, uncovering hidden gems, unique shops, and local treasures.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in quotes but can be added at checkout.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 207804

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
